items.title: Amazon Joins Goldman Sachs’ Conviction List Alongside 4 Other Stock Picks
items.summary: Goldman Sachs just overhauled its Conviction List with five new additions, and the upside targets on some of these picks will raise eyebrows. One hyperscaler alone carries a 51% potential gain, but it is far from the biggest number on the list.

items.title: Global Markets face growing pains as Goldman Sachs sees AI peak
items.summary: Global markets face downside risks from a peaking AI investment impulse in 2027, Goldman Sachs says, despite a supportive outlook for economic growth and inflation. The bank expects S&P 500 earnings growth to slow from 36% in 2026 to 11% in 2027, while AI investment and earnings continue...

items.title: Goldman Sachs sees S&P 500 rising to 8,700 next year despite slower earnings growth
items.summary: Nov 13 () - Goldman Sachs expects the benchmark S&P; 500 to climb to 8,700 points over the next 12 months, as ‌more attractive valuations following a recent sharp selloff should help ‌equities deliver positive returns despite slower earnings growth. The Wall Street brokerage's target price represents an ​over 14% upside to the index's last close of 7,592.

items.title: Goldman Sachs sees AI impulse peaking in 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs expects the boost from AI investment to peak in 2027, posing a bigger test for markets than for the broader economy, as it laid out its 10 key investment themes for next year.
